description: Marshall Girard helping Georgia O'Keeffe out of the raft. O'Keeffe is wearing a sundress.  This photograph is from the Glen Canyon Album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe 'in memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River.'
title: Marshall Girard and Georgia O'Keeffe
